_comment: Per-app/per-action takeover policy for iOS adapters. 'takeover' = always require human approval, 'approval' = approval but armed devices may auto-approve, 'autonomous' = run if device is armed. Edit this file to relax/tighten per app.
_levels: autonomous = run when device armed; approval = require human OK (auto-approved when device explicitly armed for this action); takeover = always escalate to human, even when armed
